promptSet.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production animation sprite atlas, a perfect 3 by 3 grid of NINE equally sized SQUARE frames, edge-to-edge with NO gutter, NO border, NO text or frame labels. At least 1536 by 1536 pixels. Read frames left-to-right then top-to-bottom. These are consecutive hand-drawn frames of the SAME woman crawling and lunging forward toward a FIXED first-person camera in the SAME Japanese wooden attic. Image 1 is the style, character and background reference; image 2 is the target final face/reaching hand identity reference. Keep the richly detailed black ink hatching, full muted amber wood color, deep blue roof shadows, pale grey-beige decayed skin, ragged cream long-sleeved gown, tangled straight black hair, black sunken eyes, attic rafters and vanishing point. Preserve the character identity precisely. Camera NEVER moves or zooms: her body actually changes pose and moves closer; floorboards/rafters remain registered. ONE single ghost per frame, anatomically coherent two arms, 5 fingers on each hand, non-gory horror. The final reaching hand is HER LEFT hand on SCREEN RIGHT. Maintain this handedness across all frames; other hand on SCREEN LEFT supports her weight. Every cell must have a clearly different incremental head, elbow, shoulder, knee and hair pose. Crisp ink, no motion blur, no crossfades, no photographic realism. Each square is a complete frame, not a comic page composition.
SEQUENCE A of four atlases: animation frames 1-9, distant awakening. All nine frames keep ghost small in background, centered at x50%, her full silhouette grows gradually from 18% to 30% of cell height. F1 head completely bowed behind hanging hair, hands touching floor. F2 one shoulder twitches upward. F3 head tilts 8 degrees and chin begins lifting. F4 chin lifts more, face barely seen through hair. F5 head sharply turns toward viewer, one black eye appears. F6 both black eyes look straight at viewer, mouth barely parts. F7 supporting right hand on screen left plants forward, left elbow starts unfolding. F8 left palm reaches and touches next board. F9 fingers curl around a floorboard while chest comes slightly forward; still distant and low, head fully visible. No abrupt scale jump within atlas. Background must fill all cells.
